'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Brian Fred LS Coruscant: Night Club''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Fred]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Name on sheet:''' Fred
* '''Deck name:''' Elves have milk engorged nipples!
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
